title: ZAP fails to start in "Full Layout"
body:
Issue reported in OWASP ZAP Developer Group: https://groups.google.com/d/topic/zaproxy-develop/i5nqsL_RYs4/discussion

Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run ZAP;
2. Change layout to "Full Layout" (Options > Display > "Display:" or using the main toolbar option "Expand Full")
3. Restart ZAP and note that it does not start;
4. Check the log file, there should be an exception:

```
[AWT-EventQueue-0] INFO org.parosproxy.paros.view.View  - Initialising View
[AWT-EventQueue-0] ERROR org.zaproxy.zap.ZAP$UncaughtExceptionLogger  - Exception in thread "AWT-EventQueue-0"
java.lang.NullPointerException
    at org.parosproxy.paros.view.View.getWorkbench(View.java:884)
    at org.parosproxy.paros.view.View.getMessagePanelsPositionController(View.java:327)
    at org.parosproxy.paros.view.WorkbenchPanel.initialize(WorkbenchPanel.java:188)
    at org.parosproxy.paros.view.WorkbenchPanel.changeDisplayOption(WorkbenchPanel.java:249)
    at org.parosproxy.paros.view.MainFrame.changeDisplayOption(MainFrame.java:178)
    at org.parosproxy.paros.view.MainFrame.<init>(MainFrame.java:69)
    at org.parosproxy.paros.view.View.init(View.java:227)
    at org.parosproxy.paros.view.View.getSingleton(View.java:581)
    at org.zaproxy.zap.GuiBootstrap.init(GuiBootstrap.java:135)
    at org.zaproxy.zap.GuiBootstrap.startImpl(GuiBootstrap.java:103)
    at org.zaproxy.zap.GuiBootstrap.access$0(GuiBootstrap.java:87)
    at org.zaproxy.zap.GuiBootstrap$1.run(GuiBootstrap.java:81)
    at java.awt.event.InvocationEvent.dispatch(InvocationEvent.java:312)
    at java.awt.EventQueue.dispatchEventImpl(EventQueue.java:745)
    at java.awt.EventQueue.access$300(EventQueue.java:103)
    at java.awt.EventQueue$3.run(EventQueue.java:706)
    at java.awt.EventQueue$3.run(EventQueue.java:704)
    at java.security.AccessController.doPrivileged(Native Method)
    at java.security.ProtectionDomain$1.doIntersectionPrivilege(ProtectionDomain.java:76)
    at java.awt.EventQueue.dispatchEvent(EventQueue.java:715)
    at java.awt.EventDispatchThread.pumpOneEventForFilters(EventDispatchThread.java:242)
    at java.awt.EventDispatchThread.pumpEventsForFilter(EventDispatchThread.java:161)
    at java.awt.EventDispatchThread.pumpEventsForHierarchy(EventDispatchThread.java:150)

```

Remarks:
Issue introduced in #2121 (61dab8de452dbe445e956484c085d4ec5384cdd0).

ZAP Versions:
Weekly releases >= 2015-12-14
